verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents its own schedules capability. Users can create schedules so event types are available at specific times, and can assign non-default schedules to event types. The pack has no evidence for date overrides or out-of-office periods. One older hands-on report says availability seemed limited to 9am-5pm, which adds uncertainty about how flexible working hours are but does not concretely contradict the schedules capability. Missing for 10: documented date overrides, documented out-of-office periods, detail on configuring working-hours ranges, independent corroboration of flexible working hours.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, I can define availability schedules with working hours, date overrides, and out-of-office periods

citations.quote: Create a schedule for the authenticated user. The point of creating schedules is for event types to be available at specific times.
After creating a non-default schedule, you can update an event type to point to that schedule via the PATCH `event-types/{eventTypeId}` endpoint.
